title: Home Helper Objects
hook: Name the role before touching the object.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: warm 3D home storybook, tidy rooms, familiar household objects, simple segmentation-friendly scenes; visual identity: Home Helper Objects

creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Repair Home Helper Objects by distinguishing true task aids from furniture, decor, heat appliances and storage; 'helper' means functional support, not that every object should be used by a child.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child labels what helps a task, what supports a body, what stores, and what only decorates before assigning any action.
